title: James E. Talmage
vital_facts: Married Mary May Booth 1888; eight children
Between 1891 and 1906 received a multiplicity of Baccalaureate and Doctoral Degrees
Ordained Apostle and sustained to the Twelve 1911
Died 1933 at Salt Lake City, Utah
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
